polygon.data-label: PHASE-0002 exit criterion 14 of 17, not yet met: **Added 2026-09-10.** After a week of daily use in Glass, Edwin records from the compass how often he turned to look behind and whether anything was lost there. The DES-0002 review said this question should be a criterion rather than a remark, because the literature expects a "behind you" band to become a place things are forgotten, and pushing by hand makes that easier. Either answer is a result, and a bad one is what would retire the quiet band's placement, not the phase. Edwin's, after a week of use; nothing automated stands in for it.

polygon.data-label: PHASE-0002 exit criterion 15 of 17, met: The frame time while turning is measured on the fleet's largest workspace in a foreground window and written as a number in [[FEAT-0009-The-Field-Where-Depth-Carries-Priority]], with the pooled-versus-canvas choice recorded beside it. If the number fails on a laptop, Spread returns to being the default and this note says so. Evidence, 2026-09-10: written in [[FEAT-0009-The-Field-Where-Depth-Carries-Priority]], "Measured": Your Trainer held the display's 16.7 ms median frame (17.0 ms at the 95th percentile) with two panes held and a reach drawn, 2.2 ms of script work per frame, 286 tiles and 2,303 elements at most, window in front; the hybrid is kept. Taken on a Mac Studio, not a laptop: the laptop reading is owed, and the throttled run (6.6 ms of work at 4× CPU cost) is an estimate.

polygon.data-label: PHASE-0002 exit criterion 16 of 17, not yet met: [[FEAT-0001-The-Corpus-Has-An-Inside]]'s two other measurements are written as numbers: the size and time of the one request that returns the whole edge list, and the position drift when a note is added and the layout recomputed. A planted orphan and a single-edge cluster are visible in the orbit arrangement ([[TST-0025-A-Planted-Orphan-And-A-Single-Edge-Cluster-Are-Visible]]). A measurement that fails costs the orbit arrangement, not the field, and is recorded here as an outcome. The numbers are written, 2026-09-10, in [[FEAT-0001-The-Corpus-Has-An-Inside]], "Measured": the one request is 2.39 MB and 86 ms cold on the cockpit's 1,549 notes, and the drift when a note is added is 0 on every corpus. The orphan band and the bridge colour are built and [[TST-0047-The-Orbit-Layout-Is-Solved-Once-And-Kept]] finds a planted orphan and a planted cluster; the walk [[TST-0025-A-Planted-Orphan-And-A-Single-Edge-Cluster-Are-Visible]] is Edwin's.
